prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, close-up product shot of a colorful beverage bottle labeled "lof MALTO" with playful, cartoonish graphics and Vietnamese text. The bottle is predominantly lime green with bold, contrasting text in white and dark blue, and features a cheerful blue cartoon character wearing a red cap. The lower part of the label displays a juicy, realistic illustration of an orange fruit, emphasizing freshness and flavor. The background is softly blurred, with warm orange tones and hints of teal and green, suggesting a cozy, indoor setting with bookshelves and decorative wall stickers. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy texture of the bottle and making the colors pop. The composition centers the bottle in the frame, using a shallow depth of field to draw attention to the product while keeping the background pleasantly out of focus. The overall style is clean, modern, and inviting, with a playful, youthful energy.
